feeds.title: Pragmatic Mom
feeds.description: Pragmatic Mom, curated by Mia, illuminates the parenting journey with insightful advice on education, travel, and more. With two children, she offers candid reflections and reviews on children's books and family products. Mia's blog resonates globally for its honest and practical guidance, especially on diverse children's literature. Known for extensive book lists on varied topics, Pragmatic Mom remains a trusted resource for parents worldwide.

feeds.title: Elisabeth McKnight
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Elisabeth, a Boston lifestyle blogger. This blog lives at the intersection of style and function where I share the joys (and struggles) of modern motherhood and life as a new mom.

feeds.title: BostonTechMom Blog
feeds.description: Resource for parents who want to inspire children with science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) learning. Cyndi Reitmeyer, the founder of BostonTechMom, connects parents with high-quality STEM programs that expose kids to technology in a fun, meaningful, and engaging ways.

feeds.title: The Boston Day Book
feeds.description: The Boston Day Book is a Boston-based blog written by sisters Natalie Kurtzman and Laura Chassaigne. We write about art, style, food, travel, and city living with kids.

feeds.title: Feathers and Stripes
feeds.description: I'm Alyssa, and I live just outside of Boston with my husband, our baby girl, and our dog, Sprout. Feathers and Stripes is a Popular Boston Travel and Lifestyle blog featuring travel, everyday motherhood tips, and much more.

feeds.title: Molly Katherine Photography Blog
feeds.description: Molly is a full-service Boston newborn photographer who creates organic, joy-filled portraits for modern families. Also serving Brookline, MetroWest, and Worcester.

feeds.title: When Mommy Grows Up
feeds.description: As moms, we love to inspire our kids to dream big dreams about who they'll be as they grow up. But when is the last time you stopped to ask yourself, 'Who am I going to be (next) as I grow up?' The When Mommy Grows Up Podcast is the motherhood and career podcast for moms who need help defining what success looks like to them as mid-career professionals and parents, along with the support they need to go after it. Hear real stories from real moms facing the same challenges you are...

feeds.title: Boston Chic Party
feeds.description: I'm Jenna - a Boston girl with a serious sweet tooth, an online shopping addiction, and a love for entertaining! This is my little corner of the internet where I celebrate everyday life by sharing some of my favorite things, including (but never limited to!) fashion, entertaining, yummy recipes, and anything Boston.

feeds.title: DomestikatedLife
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kate, and I live in a charming coastal town just outside of Boston with my husband and daughter. I have been blogging for over a decade, chronicling my personal adventures in entertaining, home cooking, DIY projects, and motherhood.

feeds.title: Oh, I Design
feeds.description: Oh I Design is an interior design studio & blog based in Boston, MA. Jessica Klein invites her readers in her creative exploits, endeavors and discoveries. Her blog is a creative outlet for herself and others to share and collaborate on all things design and lifestyle, focusing on interiors.

feeds.title: H.Maclean Photography Blog
feeds.description: Boston area family, newborn, and maternity photographer serving clients

feeds.title: What Moms Love
feeds.description: Covers topics like Baby, Kids, Gears, Fashion, Food, Product reviews, Gift guides, Organization, Kid-friendly recipes, DIY, and more. What Moms Love strives to be the go-to destination for discerning moms looking to stay up-to-date with the latest happenings in the big old world of kid stuff.

feeds.title: B Loved Boston
feeds.description: A Southern girl living in Boston with a passion for fashion, beauty, and life!! I created B~Loved Boston as a creative outlet to share my inspirations and finds! I'm Biana and have lived in Boston since packing everything up and moving after I graduated from the University of Florida

feeds.title: Misadventures in Mommyhood
feeds.description: Parenting Tips, Tales, & Tools. As an award-winning Blogger and Lifestyle Expert, Kristin Quinn has 15 plus years of experience in Sales & Marketing. You can find her traveling around the world with her family reviewing popular kid-friendly resorts.

feeds.title: West Boston Moms Blog
feeds.description: We are your go to resource for everything in and around the MetroWest suburbs of Boston! We have one very simple goal, providing a one stop source to give moms and dads the gift of time by having everything at your fingertips because you deserve it!

feeds.title: Debras Random Rambles
feeds.description: This blog is about lifestyle,motherhood, recipes and more. Debra works in media as self-employed, currently lives just north of Boston and is loving the environment.
